stage.$description: The presentation stage around the device: camera, light moods per scene, and the ground shadow. Backgrounds are CSS behind a transparent WebGL canvas; light moods pick one of three studio environment maps and set its intensity.

key.$description: Our choice: studio key softbox radiance

rim.$description: Our choice: vertical strips that draw the frame's edges

top.$description: Our choice: overhead strip for long highlights on the frame

bounce.$description: Our choice: a low card in front of the set, below the lens, that draws a highlight along the frame's near edges

studio.$description: Our choice: the off-camera studio's walls (linear radiance), so polished edges keep their outline on a dark set

camera.$description: Framing: the camera solves its distance so the device fills a fraction of the frame's short axis (presentation brief, principle 1), and a lens shift places it on screen without changing perspective.

default.$description: Degrees, vertical. The long, flattening lens of product photography (presentation brief, principle 7)

tight.$description: Our choice: poster-like compression for held, close shots

wide.$description: Our choice: the widest lens in the journey, for resting postures that show a surface

fill.$description: Presentation brief, principle 1: the device fills 50 to 70 percent of the frame's short axis, measured from Apple's iPhone Duo page (57 to 65 percent)

mood.$description: Light and background per scene (presentation brief, principle 3). sky and ground are the backdrop's top and bottom colours; ink is the copy's appearance; env picks the studio's light colour (neutral, warm, cool) and the studio's room takes the sky and ground; intensity scales it; turn rotates the lights about the vertical (degrees) relative to the camera, since the studio turns with the camera as the backdrop does; shadow is the contact shadow's darkness. floor and floorStrength light a pool of ground under the device on dark moods (drawn in WebGL with dithering; a CSS gradient bands on dark colours).

black.$description: Title: pure black, the key light rises from nothing (brief, scene 0)

night.$description: Our choice: the screen's glow carries the device at night

dawn.$description: Our choice: pale dawn, the end of the scene 1 ramp

morning.$description: Measured: Apple's background-alt rgb(245, 245, 247), the calmest frame (brief, scene 2)

day.$description: Our choice: brighter, a rim along the hinge for the work register (brief, scene 3)

office.$description: Our choice: cooler and flatter than the morning (brief, scene 4)

book.$description: Our choice: warm and close, held in the hands (brief, scene 5)

evening.$description: Our choice: golden-hour kitchen, a warm key low from the side (brief, scene 6)

dusk.$description: Measured: Apple's hinge-story blue-gray rgb(57, 68, 82) at the top (brief, scene 7)

title.$description: Title: after the black, a single key rises until the device's edges read (brief, scene 0)

twilight.$description: Our choice: the blue hour between night and dawn, so the scrubbed dawn passes through blue, not grey
